---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to the reconstruction or the agent tooling
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem, e.g. "I can't tell which folder answers question X..."

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What should be added or changed (new analysis doc, extra XML template, new automation snippet...).

**Where should it live?**
- [ ] `analysis/` — deeper analysis of an SDK / permission / component
- [ ] `agent.md` — new extraction recipe or rebuild step
- [ ] `skills/android-xml-input/` — new reference or template
- [ ] `docs/` — new guide

**Additional context**
Links, prior art, or the exact APK artifact the feature should explain.
